purpose: Test whether deterministic full-batch L-BFGS resolves the remaining motor-map precision error, then measure physical coverage on new scenes. Preserve every earlier candidate and result.
observer: Unchanged V4 observer, rigid keypoint fit and calibration from models/bottle_servo_v1.
controller: Unchanged V2 R1 routing and refusal limits. Only the neural motor weights may change.

motor_training.optimizer: L-BFGS, full 4056-point training set, FP32 CUDA
motor_training.loss: Unchanged V3 loss: position residual / 5 mm and local-Y-up axis residual / 0.05, summed over coordinates and divided by three times the training-point count, plus 0.01 normalized joint-reference MSE.
motor_training.selection: Only if all 500 updates complete within budget: most accepted original exposed kinematic development points, then lowest p95 position error, from exactly the 150/500-update candidates. No physical result selects or changes weights.

scope: A better offline fit alone is insufficient. No runtime inverse solver, simulator object-pose action inputs, demonstration retrieval, hidden assistance, new controller revision or relaxed acceptance threshold. V3 remains stopped; its unused physical seeds and all previous final seeds stay excluded from this experiment. Stop before final physical evaluation if a gate fails.
